Listed below are some FAQs about our team and services.

## Team Processes

- I am new to the Engineering team. Where do I start?

First off, welcome to the team! Check out [Getting Started]() for an overview of our services. To learn how to set up your machine and information our development process, visit [Developer Info]({{"doc/developer-info/landing.html" | absolute_url}}). Eventually you will be familiar enough with your services to support them. Before you become part of the rotation, read about [Pager Duty]({{"doc/support-playbook/pager-duty.html" | absolute_url}}).

- What is the support process in production?

Visit the [Support playbook]() for information on monitoring, troubleshooting and pager duty.

## Integration

- How do I integrate with your services?

A great place to start is to read the [API integration guide]() on Git Hub. It describes our services and has sample code and step-by-step instructions for each use case. If you have further questions, contact us on [#Slack]().
   
- How long does integration generally take?

Depending upon the complexity of the integration, it can take 2 - 6 weeks to integrate, end-to-end test and deploy to production.

- What version of your services should I use?

The latest version is 3.0. We are currently working with teams still using 2.0 to migrate within the next couple of months.
